name: voicehire-appium-tests
description: Appium E2E tests for the VoiceHire Android app. Isolated from the app: installing here adds nothing to mobile/, voice_hire_v2/ or voicehire-backend/.
_notes: Run `npm install` in THIS folder only.
One-time driver setup:  npx appium driver install uiautomator2
Start the server in a second terminal:  npx appium
The app must already be installed on the device, or pass APP_PATH to install it:
DEVICE=RMX2193 npm test         target a specific device
Requires a real device or emulator visible to `adb devices`.
Selectors use accessibility ids taken from the app's accessibilityLabel props.
